title: Western Europe Group Tour: Alps to Amsterdam
alt: Windmills at Zaanse Schans reflected in the water
transport: Group coach throughout with a tour manager and airport transfers

stops.name: Zurich
stops.subtitle: Zurich → Grindelwald and Titlis
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Modern airport hotel with a shuttle into the city

activities.name: Grindelwald and Interlaken day trip
activities.description: A day into the Bernese Oberland, with the meadows below the Eiger north face and the two lakes either side of Interlaken.

activities.name: Mount Titlis cable car
activities.description: The rotating cable car to three thousand metres above Engelberg, with the glacier cave and the cliff walk at the top.

activities.name: Lucerne orientation tour
activities.description: A walk round the old town with the covered Chapel Bridge, the Lion Monument and the lakefront promenade.

program.name: Zurich
program.description: Three nights in Switzerland with Grindelwald and Interlaken, the Mount Titlis cable car and the old town at Lucerne.

stops.name: Frankfurt
stops.subtitle: Frankfurt → Rhine Falls and the Black Forest
stops.hotel: Crowne Plaza Frankfurt Congress Hotel by IHG
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large business hotel close to the exhibition grounds

activities.name: Rhine Falls boat tour
activities.description: A boat run out to the rock in the middle of the largest waterfall in Europe, taken on the way north out of Switzerland.

program.name: Frankfurt
program.description: One night in Germany, reached through the Rhine Falls and the clock making villages of the Black Forest.

stops.name: Amsterdam
stops.subtitle: Amsterdam → Cologne and Zaanse Schans
stops.hotel: Vienna House Easy by Wyndham Amsterdam Airport
stops.accom: 2 nights · All meals · Standard room · 4★ · Bright airport hotel on the Schiphol rail line

activities.name: Cologne Cathedral
activities.description: The twin spired Gothic cathedral beside the Rhine, six centuries in the building and the tallest church in Europe for a time.

activities.name: Zaanse Schans day trip
activities.description: The working windmills on the Zaan, with the clog maker, the cheese farm and the green timber houses along the water.

activities.name: Amsterdam sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided round of the canal belt, Dam Square, the Rijksmuseum quarter and the narrow merchant houses of the Jordaan.

activities.name: Amsterdam evening canal cruise
activities.description: A glass topped boat along the canal belt after dark, when the bridges and the gabled fronts are all lit.

program.name: Amsterdam
program.description: Two nights in the Netherlands with the windmills at Zaanse Schans, a city tour and an evening canal cruise.

stops.name: Paris
stops.subtitle: Paris → Brussels on the way
stops.hotel: Hotel Inn Paris - Roissy Cdg Airport
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Convenient hotel by Charles de Gaulle with a free shuttle

activities.name: Brussels city tour
activities.description: A stop in the Belgian capital for the guild houses of the Grand Place, the Atomium and the Manneken Pis.

activities.name: Paris highlights orientation tour
activities.description: A guided loop past the Louvre, the Arc de Triomphe, the Champs Elysees, Notre Dame and the Place de la Concorde.

activities.name: Eiffel Tower second floor tickets
activities.description: Admission to the second floor of the tower, the level where the ironwork and the view over the rooftops both read best.

activities.name: Seine river cruise
activities.description: An hour on the Seine past the Louvre, the Musee d'Orsay, Notre Dame and the Ile de la Cite from the water.

program.name: Paris
program.description: Three nights to finish, reached through Brussels, with a city tour, the Eiffel Tower and a Seine cruise.

expert.name: Sharon
expert.quote: Four countries in nine nights on a group coach with a tour manager. For a first trip to Europe it is far better value than doing it alone.
expert.tip: Carry one Schengen visa for the whole run. Apply through the Swiss consulate since Switzerland is where you spend the most nights.

summary: Ten days by coach across Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands and France: Grindelwald and Mount Titlis, the Rhine Falls and the Black Forest, Cologne Cathedral, the windmills at Zaanse Schans, Brussels, and Paris with the Eiffel Tower and a Seine cruise.
included: Included: 9 nights in four star hotels across Zurich, Frankfurt, Amsterdam and Paris with breakfast and dinner in Amsterdam; all coach travel and airport transfers; a tour manager; the Grindelwald and Interlaken day trip; Mount Titlis cable car tickets; a Lucerne orientation tour; a Rhine Falls boat tour; Cologne Cathedral; the Zaanse Schans day trip; an Amsterdam sightseeing tour; an Amsterdam evening canal cruise; a Brussels city tour; a guided orientation tour of the Paris highlights; entry to the second floor of the Eiffel Tower; an hour on the Seine by boat.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees and visa assistance; lunches and dinners other than those listed; travel insurance; personal expenses.
